title: Grateful Dead Live at Dream Bowl on 1969-02-22
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Remastered soundboard capture delivers crystal‑clear audio of a smoking ’69 show featuring a stellar Dark Star, Mountains of the Moon and an electrifying Eleven sequence.
ai_review.review: The new Charlie Miller remaster transforms what was once a muddy tape into one of the most vivid recordings of 1969, with pristine instrument separation and no hiss. Musically the concert is a high‑energy masterpiece – Dark Star, Mountains of the Moon, The Other One and the Doin’ That Rag → St. Stephen → The Eleven sequence are repeatedly singled out as highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews praise both the upgraded soundboard quality and the exceptional performance; only a few moderate ratings slightly lower the average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remaster eliminates hiss, restores crystal‑clear instrument separation, fixes bass distortion and provides dynamic, balanced mix – a huge step up from earlier muddy transfers.

standout_songs: Doin' That Rag > St. Stephen > The Eleven
poor_songs: Dark Star (minor lyrical flub mentioned by one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set that builds into an epic Dark Star jam, followed by a second set featuring a tight transition from Doin' That Rag through St. Stephen into a scorching Eleven; overall flow is praised as inspired and seamless.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone described as crystal‑clear and “so good”; possibly played on a Gibson SG, his playing shines especially on Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass distortion removed in the new transfer; his bass work highlighted on The Eleven and Lovelight.
